description:
This protocol performs the post RC-PCR pooling of the Nimagen SARS CoV-2 Library Prep. It has the option to pool samples from a variety of 384 well plates. The 384 well plate is divided into four quadrants and each quadrant can have up to 12 columns of samples, yielding a total of 48 columns worth of samples on a full plate.

Note: The diagram above color coordinates the four quadrant positions. Each quadrant can take up to 12 columns worth of samples. The diagram above shows 1 column worth of samples.

Opentrons 20uL Filter Tips

Eppendorf Twin.tec LoBind 384 Well
Eppendorf Twin.tec LoBind 96 Well
P300 Single Channel GEN2
P20 Multichannel GEN2

For more detailed information on compatible labware, please visit our Labware Library.


Deck Setup

Note: Slots 9, 10, 11 contain empty tip racks for the Opentrons 20 uL tips.
Protocol Steps

Mix column in the 384 well donor plate, then transfer sample to the first column of the 96 well recipient plate. This step should proceed for all available columns in all four quadrants.
Mix well A1 and then transfer the total volume of samples in A1 of the 96 well recipient plate to the 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube in position A1 of the tube rack. This step should proceed for all wells in column 1 (A1-H1).
